name: blueprint/weather-alert
description: Forecast thresholds become reminders: check the forecast, schedule an event at the crossing time, deliver through the reminder flow
recipe: fetch the forecast -> compare against the stored thresholds -> on crossing: create an event at the forecast time -> the due check delivers it and marks it notified
pitfalls: forecasts change - re-check before the event fires
absent fields are omitted, not null (weather schemas)
the event is local time - mind the machine timezone
